close_reason: Fixed: cross-references changed to '(seed.rs: DAYS_AGO_N)' — colon-separated not module path
description: The oracle comments in seed_fixture_tests.rs say '(seed.rs ts::DAYS_AGO_30)' and '(seed.rs ts::DAYS_AGO_10)'. The 'ts' module is declared 'mod ts' (private) inside seed.rs; it is not pub and not re-exported. A reader in seed_fixture_tests.rs cannot navigate to that symbol: it is not in scope, not visible in rustdoc, and not findable by IDE go-to-definition from the test file. The reference gives the file but not the line, and the module is not pub. Either make 'ts' pub (so 'seed.rs ts::DAYS_AGO_30' is a real path that IDE tools resolve), or replace the reference with the actual ISO timestamp value that the reader can grep for.
title: ts:: oracle references in seed_fixture_tests.rs are non-navigable
